subject: Reconcile R7 economics alignment with R10 transaction architecture
body: R10 reassignment is acknowledged and its initial transaction-adapter architecture is ready for reconciliation. R7 has proposed sharing R10 transaction_id/operation_id/attempt_id as the economics denominator hierarchy rather than creating a separate economics state machine, with CONFIRMED_BOOKED as the authoritative booking count and reconciliation/human recovery represented as first-class cost events. Manager-01 and Manager-02 should jointly review this cross-lane alignment for semantic correctness, privacy/security implications, idempotency/reconciliation consistency, observability burden, and whether the metrics model could incentivize unsafe retries or premature confirmation. Publish one reconciled recommendation or explicit remaining disagreement for Primary disposition. Do not weaken the P0 gate or authorize live adapters.
